candidate.name: MCL Two-Speed Auction Relay
candidate.purpose: one mutually exclusive auction state machine targeting ordinary qualified activity without a trade quota

causal_data.source: IBKR dated NYMEX CL and MCL futures
causal_data.session: Sunday-Friday 18:00-17:00 America/New_York with the 17:00-18:00 maintenance halt excluded
causal_data.common_clock: exact timestamp inner join after matched-month selection
causal_data.missing_challenge_period: 2023-07-01 through the first authentic August-2024 overlap remains a hard coronation blocker
prohibitions: no forward-filled missing CL or MCL bar

contract_owner.primary_roll: at the next session boundary after both next-month CL and MCL prior-complete-session volume exceed the current month; force roll no later than three complete NYMEX sessions before MCL expiry
controls: MCL-only prior-session volume cross with the same forced boundary
invariants: never revert to an earlier month after rolling
CL and MCL always use the same contract month
flatten and reset auction/indicator state at a contract roll
record selected conIds, local symbols, source hashes, and all mapping failures

state_machine.balance: prior completed 60- or 90-minute CL range with path efficiency at or below 0.35 or 0.45; boundaries and session VWAP exclude the decision bar
state_machine.probe: CL trades beyond the frozen balance boundary by 0.05 or 0.10 of causal 60-minute true range
state_machine.acceptance: two or three consecutive completed one-minute CL closes remain beyond the frozen boundary, completed five-minute direction agrees, and exact-month MCL return agrees
state_machine.failure: within three or five completed one-minute bars after a probe, CL closes back inside the frozen boundary by at least 0.05 true range and exact-month MCL return agrees with reversal
state_machine.mutual_exclusion: a probe can mature into acceptance or failure once, never both; no overlapping position or pyramiding
state_machine.entry: next MCL one-minute open after the completed maturation bar
state_machine.acceptance_exit: first completed close back inside the balance boundary, opposite completed five-minute turn, 1.0 true-range adverse stop, or 60-minute timeout
state_machine.failure_exit: session VWAP touch, probe-extreme violation plus 0.10 true range, opposite completed five-minute turn, or 30-minute timeout
state_machine.session_safety: no entry after 16:25 ET and force flat by 16:55 ET; no position crosses the daily halt or a contract roll
state_machine.daily_limit: at most three new positions per NYMEX trading date; this is a risk ceiling, never a quota

bounded_cells.evaluation_law: evaluate the 32 declared cells once; rank on the discovery slice without changing dimensions, then open the single winner and its immediate one-coordinate neighbours on validation

economics.execution_semantics: next-bar MCL open moved adversely by the declared ticks plus explicit per-side fees; every forced flat and roll is costed

proof_windows.discovery: first complete year available after common-tape warmup, ending no later than 2025-08-03
proof_windows.full_available: all authentic common tape from August 2024 through 2026-08-03
proof_windows.future_blind_challenge: July-2023-to-August-2024 archive, acquired without modifying the frozen candidate

gates.ordinary_activity_target: approximately one to two qualified positions per active day without forced entries
gates.annual_net_after_primary_cost: positive in every complete available and future blind year
gates.directionality: full-period up and down attribution both nonnegative, with neither branch funding an otherwise losing system
gates.branch_reliability: acceptance and failure each report cadence, PnL, PF, MFE, MAE, and drawdown independently
gates.concentration: no single month may contribute more than 40 percent of positive full-period PnL
gates.data_integrity: zero unexplained common-clock gaps, contract mismatches, roll reversions, lookahead timestamps, or mapping failures
gates.coronation: forbidden until the July-2023 challenge, authentic broker preview/cost, runtime parity, capital allocation, restart, reconciliation, and safety gates all pass

reporting: net PnL, PF, closed and intrabar DD, PnL/DD, trades/year, win rate, average hold, MFE, MAE and giveback
annual, monthly, direction, branch, NYMEX session-third, volatility-quartile, weekday and roll-neighbour attribution
CL-to-MCL parity, entry spread stress, missing bars, selected month and state transition census
TA-only baseline beside news-tagged cohorts; news cannot change these v1 decisions
